test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What significant milestone did India achieve in satellite communication (satcom) as of 21 May 2025?

options.text: Initiated the fastest global rollout of satellite-based communication services
Completed the construction of a national space station
Banned all foreign satellite communication providers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Initiated the fastest global rollout of satellite-based communication services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **21 May 2025**, India achieved a significant milestone in satellite communication by initiating the **fastest global rollout of satellite-based communication services**.
 
• This milestone is a testament to India's advancements in the field of **satellite technology**, ensuring seamless and high-speed connectivity even in remote and inaccessible areas.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's vision of providing universal access to modern communication services, bridging the **digital divide** across the nation.
 
• Unlike other satellite communication milestones, such as launching advanced satellites or building space stations, this achievement focuses on the **rapid implementation** and operationalization of satellite-based communication systems globally.
 
• This rollout integrates cutting-edge technologies, making India a leader in **satellite communication innovation** and positioning itself as a global hub for satellite-based services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Satellite Communication:**

 
 
• Satellite communication refers to the use of satellites to transmit data across vast distances, ensuring connectivity in regions where traditional network infrastructure is not feasible.
 
• India's satellite communication systems are managed by **ISRO** (Indian Space Research Organisation), which has pioneered advancements in space technology.
 
• These systems are vital for applications such as **telecommunication, broadcasting, navigation, and disaster management**.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Initiative:**
 
 
• The rollout of satellite-based communication services aligns with the **Digital India initiative**, which aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• This initiative emphasizes enhancing internet connectivity and providing access to online services across the country.
 
 
 
• **Global Trends in Satellite Communication:**
 
 
• Globally, satellite communication is gaining traction for connecting rural and underserved regions. Companies like **SpaceX's Starlink** and **Amazon Kuiper** are also major players in this domain.
 
• India's rapid rollout places it in competition with these global giants, showcasing its capability in deploying efficient satellite systems.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Satellite Communication:**
 
 
• Satellite communication provides **high-speed internet** and reliable connectivity, especially in geographically challenging terrains.
 
• It plays a crucial role in **disaster management**, enabling real-time communication during emergencies.
 
• Its applications extend to sectors like agriculture, education, healthcare, and transportation, facilitating technological advancements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **ISRO's Role:**

 
 
• ISRO, as India's premier space agency, has been instrumental in developing and deploying satellite-based communication systems.
 
• Its achievements include launching satellites like **GSAT series** for communication and **NavIC** for navigation.
 
 
 
• **Policy Framework:**
 
 
• India's satellite communication rollout is supported by policies promoting **public-private partnerships** and encouraging technological innovation.
 
• These policies aim to enhance the accessibility and affordability of satellite-based services, ensuring their integration into mainstream communication systems.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• India's success in this domain opens avenues for collaboration with global players, boosting technological exchange and economic growth.
 
• The advancements in satellite communication will further contribute to India's aspirations of becoming a **space superpower**.
